name: lasting-plans
description: 📜 Keeps every Claude Code plan and playbook in local, Git-versioned archives (~/Claude-plans, ~/Claude-playbooks), out of reach of the cleanup that deletes old plans. It imports existing files, watches for changes on macOS, keeps the archive copy when a source disappears, and records creation dates, Finder tags and labels. A CLI searches, shows history and restores; a remote backup is optional.
